metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant was like ‘Nah, you don’t deserve this but take it anyway’
metadata.description:
Aim checked out but somehow got a kill.
Enemy probably considering new career options.
Valorant logic: handing out freebies like it’s casual Friday.
Click if your brain was AFK but the kill still hit!

Hit like if your aim ghosted but the kills kept coming!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
